description: A learner mastered an individual item (lemma or morpheme pattern). Milestone notification for badges and analytics — not a BKT posterior dump. Authoritative per-item model state lives in spec-server's private database.

learnerDid.description: The learner who mastered this item.

itemId.description: The mastered item identifier. Format: dict:lemma:{id} or dict:pattern:{id}.

itemType.description: Whether this is a vocabulary lemma or a morpheme pattern.

masteredAt.description: UTC timestamp when mastery was achieved.

sessionId.description: The learning session that produced this mastery notification.

encounterCountAtMastery.description: Number of encounters recorded before this mastery milestone.

sourceEventRef.description: Opaque, server-resolvable reference to the private tools.spec.private.learner.spectrumState update (spec-server) whose W crossing triggered this milestone. Correlation token only — it does NOT carry priorW/posteriorW or any (W, kappa, F) value inline; the authoritative per-node state stays private. New records MAY instead use the structured tools.spec.event.defs#privateRecordRef shape (refType 'spectrumState'). See RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S2.

register.description: Register of the content where mastery was achieved.
